note: Buildings made of the Medieval Village MegaKit (assets/models/medieval_kit). tools/make_kit_buildings.py writes their visuals into assets/data/visuals.json. cells: [x, z] in 2 m cells (x is the gable side: 2, 3 or 4; z at least x); floors: 1 or 2; style: plaster or brick; the door is on the +z front, in the middle.
